question: Should Control UI gain a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current send-shortcut/autogrowing inline composer remain the supported long-prompt direction?
rationale: The requested behavior adds a new composer mode with draft ownership, keyboard, attachment, focus, and send semantics; current main solves only the shortcut overlap, and the open composer-redesign PR may change the right UX shape.

options.title: Keep as focused expanded-composer follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement a modal editor only after the active composer redesign direction is clear, with focused UI and E2E coverage for Apply, Cancel, Send, focus, attachments, and shortcuts.

options.title: Fold into the composer redesign
options.body: Ask the related composer-redesign PR to explicitly own or reject the expanded-modal workflow before landing, so this issue can close only if that PR covers the requested behavior.

options.title: Choose inline composition only
options.body: Close this direction after a maintainer states that configurable send shortcuts plus inline growth are the supported long-prompt UX and a modal should not be added.

recommendation.title: Keep as focused expanded-composer follow-up
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement a modal editor only after the active composer redesign direction is clear, with focused UI and E2E coverage for Apply, Cancel, Send, focus, attachments, and shortcuts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing candidate from the issue discussion and recent current-main composer/send-shortcut history.
